description:
Hushfeed v0.21.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

New here: a daily budget for the feed with an optional hold that leaves messages, profiles and search alone, a Hook status row that says which of the things the patches look for are actually in this build, counts written the way the feed writes them so a filter takes 20K or 1.5M, and a long press that saves the sound a video was made with rather than the mix it ends up with. A still sticker is no longer written out as a one-frame GIF, a download no longer gains a _2 that nothing was using, and a saved sticker reports the path it actually went to.

Validation: 577 runtime tests passed locally. The bundle carries 68 patches and passed checks for all three DEX payloads; every patch but AMOLED dark theme applied to a stock 46.2.3 APK in one run at 640 MB, the only miss being the known Downloads fingerprint. Diagnostic exports redact signed URLs and credentials before they are copied or saved. None of the new switches has been seen on a phone: the roadmap lists a device check for each one.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
